Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nLocate the duct that leads out of the hangar.\nThe security override switch is in the control room. This will bring up the jets.
Translation: Sven Viking (无线电):\n找到通往机库外的管道。\n安全覆写开关在控制室内。这将启动喷气机。

Title: NETMESSAGE:OBJECTIVE UPDATE\n\nMove on and find the the security override switch.
Translation: 目标更新\n\n继续前进，找到安全覆写开关。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:OBJECTIVE UPDATE

Bring up the jets to plant C4 on them.
Then leave via the ductpassage.
Translation:
目标更新

启动喷气机并在上面安放C4。
然后通过管道通道离开。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:WARNING!

C4 planted.
Leave the area immediately.
Explosion DANGER.
Translation:
警告！

C4已安放。
立即离开该区域。
爆炸危险！

Title:
NETMESSAGE:WARNING!

Friendly airstrike on the way.
Take cover!!
Translation:
警告！

友军空袭即将到来。
找掩护！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nBlast doors are open, the planes are out. Airstrike is a go!
Translation: Sven Viking (无线电):\n防爆门已打开，飞机已出动。空袭开始！
